packageRules.description: Group all @ai-sdk/* packages so they update together
Disable major version updates for GitHub Actions - current v4 setup works, avoid disruptive jumps
Disable major version updates for core runner dependencies - breaking changes in these can silently break model integrations
Disable eslint major updates - typescript-eslint v8 only supports eslint v8/v9, re-enable when typescript-eslint drops v10 support
Disable TypeScript major updates until the compiler API and typescript-eslint support them
Keep Node types aligned with the Node 24 runtime used by CI and releases
Presence is pinned by a benchmark eval and must be upgraded deliberately with that eval
Root devDependencies let component eval answers typecheck. A 0.x minor bump is breaking, so upgrade these deliberately with the evals that pin them; patches are fine
esbuild is pinned to the exact version convex depends on so the query sandbox bundles like Convex does; bump it only when convex does
